recognize_zh: 單一視野內有七、八顆嗜酸性球聚集，細胞質充滿橘紅色粗顆粒；部分核呈單葉、環狀或三葉等異常分葉，少數顆粒分布不均，提示嗜酸性球增多且可能有形態異常，但確診 CEL 仍需克隆性證據。
features: Marked increase in eosinophils, with seven to eight in a single field
Abundant coarse orange-red eosinophilic granules filling the cytoplasm
Nuclear abnormalities including non-lobated/ring-like, bilobed, and trilobed forms
Uneven granule distribution with focal clear areas in some cells
Mature forms predominate; no blasts in this field
Background red cells with some elongated/teardrop-like forms, likely partly smear-related
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking eosinophilia, with numerous mature eosinophils clustered in a single field. The eosinophils contain abundant coarse orange-red granules, some with uneven distribution and focal clear areas, and several show abnormal nuclear segmentation including non-lobated or ring-like and trilobed nuclei. No blasts are identified in this field. Morphology alone cannot establish clonality; the findings are consistent with marked eosinophilia and, with demonstrated clonality and exclusion of reactive causes and rearranged tyrosine kinase genes, support chronic eosinophilic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils can look identical, so exclusion of secondary causes and absence of clonal markers are required.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangement
ddx.vs: These are defined by FISH or molecular detection of the gene rearrangement, not by eosinophil morphology.
Idiopathic HES has persistent eosinophilia with organ damage but no demonstrable clonality or increased blasts.
It is identified by an aberrant cytokine-producing T-cell population (e.g., CD3-negative CD4-positive) on flow cytometry.
